text: Ringing about my nephew, 7, I'm looking after him this week. Temp 38.9 tonight. About 40 mins ago he had a fit. He went stiff, then his arms and legs were shaking and his eyes rolled up. He's never had one before. It's over now and he's wide awake, chatting to me and watching cartoons. One other thing: he hasn't had a wee since this morning, so well over 12 hours. Also how much paracetamol or ibuprofen can I give him for his age? I haven't given anything yet.
